name: clinicedc/edc
what_it_is: A Django-based electronic data capture (EDC) framework for building multisite, randomized longitudinal clinical trials; used in production for NIH-funded HIV, diabetes, and hypertension trials across Africa. It is an eSource system rather than a traditional EDC, collecting data at point-of-care into electronic CRFs with embedded validation.
components: edc-lab (specimen requisition and reference range grading)
measurement: Lab result grading against CTCAE/DAIDS reference ranges
QA reports and online quality assurance
configuration: Named visit schedules linked to consent version
Metadata rules for adaptive data collection
Per-device role assignment for multisite deployments
constraints: Requires Python 3.12+ and Django 5.2+; MySQL 8+ is the only supported database
Field-level encryption keys must be backed up separately; loss renders encrypted data unrecoverable
Celery with Redis required for async tasks; not designed for synchronous-only production operation
Consent versioning tightly coupled to data collection; CRF permissions enforced by consent period lifecycle
No docker-compose; deploys on bare-metal Ubuntu with systemd, Nginx, and MySQL
notable_absences: No offline-first/PWA support at application level
